public_distribution.rule: Ship the new SVG/PNG template, compiler and metadata. Generate native resources from the user's own game; never bundle an XBE, disc or native retail resource.

runtime.scope: Native relocation, formatters, font selection, glyphs, score phases, camera contraction and overlapping decompression are bounded CPU evidence. Raster output is a software model. No gameplay or GPU witness; team selection, live timeouts and isolated new-font binding are deferred.
